stem:
Meera drops her bar magnet into a box of iron nails while helping in her father's shop in Jaipur. When she lifts the magnet out, she looks at where the nails are sticking.
Where will most of the iron nails stick to the bar magnet?

options.text: Mostly at the middle of the magnet, where it is thickest
Mostly near the two ends of the magnet
Equally at every point along the whole magnet
Only at the end that is painted red

teacher.key_rationale: A bar magnet's attraction is strongest at its two poles, which are near its two ends, so most nails cluster there. Option A reverses the relationship (middle strongest), C omits the condition that strength varies with position, and D captures a surface feature (paint colour) rather than magnetic structure.
